content:
**1) LAYOUT**
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 - 1024, 45):** Contains app icon/title (left), "Buy Now" CTA and window controls (right).
*   **Navigation/Toolbar Bar (0, 45 - 1024, 110):**
    *   Left: Navigation cluster (Home, Back, Forward, Up buttons + Address bar showing drive icon + "Windows (C:)").
    *   Right: View toggle (List), Filter button, Search box.
*   **Tab Bar (0, 135 - 265, 180):** Two tabs: "Path" (Active), "Type" (Inactive). Aligned to the left edge of the Tree Pane.
*   **Main Content Area (0, 180 - 1024, 855):** Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Tree Pane (Left) (0, 180 - 265, 855):** Hierarchical file tree. Width ~265px.
    *   **File List (Center) (265, 180 - 795, 855):** Data grid with columns: Checkbox, Name, Date Modified, Type. Width ~530px.
    *   **Preview/Details Pane (Right) (795, 180 - 1024, 855):** Shows selected item preview (Icon, Name, "Open" button, Size info). Width ~229px.
*   **Status Bar / Footer (0, 855 - 1024, 940):**
    *   Left: Success status message with checkmark icon.
    *   Right: Primary action button ("Recover All ...").
*   **Windows Taskbar (Bottom):** Standard Windows 11 taskbar at the bottom of the screen.

**2) TEXT (Verbatim)**
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Toolbar Button:** `Buy Now`
*   **Address Bar:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Search Box Placeholder:** `Search files or folders`
*   **Filter Button:** `Filter`
*   **Tabs:** `Path`, `Type`
*   **Column Headers:** `(Checkbox)`, `Name`, `Date Modified`, `Type`
*   **Tree Items:** `Windows (C:)`, `1.1M`, `File Path Lost`, `4.3K`, `Reconstructed`, `88`
*   **List Items (Name):** `actionarchivecache`, `actions-runner`, `azureCli`, `cobertura-2.1.1`, `ghcup`, `hostedtoolcache`, `image`, `inetpub`, `Julia`, `mingw32`
*   **List Items (Type):** `File folder` (repeated for all visible rows)
*   **List Items (Dates):** `10/7/2026 11:30 PM`, `10/17/2026 4:38 PM`, `10/8/2026 1:50 AM`, `2/26/2015 11:23 PM`, `10/8/2026 12:32 PM`, `10/7/2026 11:25 PM` (truncated?), `10/7/2026 9:08 PM`, `10/7/2026 10:10 PM`, `10/7/2026 11:21 PM`, `2/19/2026 12:59 PM`
*   **Preview Pane:** `actionarchivecache`, `Open`, `Size`, `284 MB`
*   **Toast/Popup:** `AI Recommend available.`, `View Details`
*   **Footer Status:** `Scan Completed, Files Found: 1139250 (149.73 GB)`
*   **Footer Button:** `Recover All ...`

**3) COLOR (Estimated Hex)**
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/App Background: `#F5F7FA` (Light Blue-Grey)
    *   Title Bar: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Tree/List Item Hover/Selected: `#E1E8F5` (Light Blue)
    *   List Header Background: `#F0F2F5` (Very Light Grey)
    *   Preview Pane Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Accents & CTAs:**
    *   Primary Blue (Buy Now, Recover All, Open Button, Sort Arrow): `#3B82F6` or `#2563EB`
    *   Toast Background: `#2563EB` (Solid Blue)
    *   Toast Button: `#FFFFFF` (White bg, Blue text)
    *   Footer Checkmark Circle: `#EFF6FF` (Bg), `#3B82F6` (Icon)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Names, Headers): `#1F2937` (Dark Grey/Black)
    *   Secondary Text (Dates, Type, Size, Counts): `#6B7280` (Medium Grey)
    *   Text on Blue (Toast, Buttons): `#FFFFFF`
*   **Borders/Separators:**
    *   Dividers: `#E5E7EB` (Light Grey)

**4) TYPOGRAPHY (Estimates)**
*   **Title Bar:** Segoe UI (or System UI), ~9-10px, Regular.
*   **Headers (Columns, Tree Root):** Segoe UI, ~12-13px, Medium/SemiBold.
*   **List Content (Names/Dates):** Segoe UI, ~12px, Regular.
*   **Status Bar/Footer:** Segoe UI, ~13-14px, Regular/Medium for label, Bold for numbers (`1139250`).

**5) SPACING & SIZING**
*   **Row Height (List/Tree):** ~36-40px.
*   **Control Heights:**
    *   Address Bar/Search: ~32-36px.
    *   Buttons (Filter, Open, Recover): ~32-36px.
    *   Tabs: ~32px height.
*   **Padding:**
    *   List Item Padding Left: ~12-16px.
    *   Preview Pane Padding: ~24px.
*   **Icons:**
    *   Toolbar Icons: 16x16px.
    *   File/Folder Icons (List): 24x24px or 32x32px.
    *   File/Folder Icon (Preview): 96x96px (Large).
*   **Radii:**
    *   Buttons: ~4-6px (Rounded corners).
    *   Search/Input fields: ~4-6px.
    *   Toast Popup: ~8px.
*   **Stroke Widths:** Borders are ~1px solid.

**6) CONTROLS & STATES**
*   **Buttons:**
    *   `Buy Now`: Normal (Orange/Yellow accent).
    *   `Filter`: Normal (Grey text/icon).
    *   `Open` (Preview): Normal (Blue filled).
    *   `Recover All ...`: Normal (Blue filled, large).
    *   `View Details` (Toast): Normal (White button on blue).
*   **Inputs:**
    *   Search Box: Empty state (Placeholder visible).
    *   Address Bar: Read-only display state.
*   **Tabs:**
    *   `Path`: Selected/Active (White background, top border integration).
    *   `Type`: Inactive (Grey background).
*   **List/Tree:**
    *   Row `actionarchivecache`: Selected State (Blue highlight background).
    *   Checkboxes: Unchecked, square style.
    *   Sort Indicator: Up arrow visible on `Name` column.
*   **Toast Notification:** Visible/Active state, floating over the right pane.

**7) ICONOGRAPHY**
*   **Style:** Fluent Design / Windows 11 Style (Outline and Filled mixed).
*   **Nav Icons:** Outline (Home, Arrow Left/Right, Arrow Up).
*   **File Icons:** Filled (Folder icons in Yellow/Blue).
*   **Action Icons:** Outline (List view, Filter funnel, Search magnifying glass).
*   **System Icons:** Standard Windows controls (Min, Max, Close).

**8) STATE**
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Populated**. The scan is finished ("Scan Completed"), data is listed, and a selection is active.
*   **Contextual State:**
    *   The folder `actionarchivecache` is selected in the list.
    *   The Preview pane reflects this selection.
    *   An "AI Recommend" toast is currently visible, suggesting an active contextual prompt or feature introduction.
    *   A "Copilot" or AI assistant icon is visible in the bottom right corner of the content area (near the toast origin).
